name: FSA Restaurant Culinary & Grounding Evaluation
description: Evaluation set benchmarking Google Maps grounding and 6-pillar culinary anthropologist scoring for authentic vs generic vs excluded venues.

parts.text: Research 'Taste of Sichuan' located at 123 High St, London E1 6AN. Ground with Google Maps and score against the 6 culinary anthropologist pillars.
Research 'Rasa N16' located at 56 Stoke Newington Church St, London N16 0NB for authentic South Indian Keralan regional depth.
Research 'Bella Italia' located at Leicester Square, London WC2H 7NA. Evaluate if it passes the insider community signal or gets penalized as generic tourist dining.
Research 'Costa Coffee & Bakery' located at Oxford St, London W1D 1BS. Check if establishment integrity strictly disqualifies it.
Research 'Crispy Fried Chicken Express' located at Commercial Rd, London E1 1RD. Confirm establishment integrity exclusion.
